_comment: Controlled vocabulary for the ServerOS Meeting relevance / retention kernel.
This file is DATA. It declares the closed sets the kernel decides in, the
relevance rules a policy may name, and the user's declared protected
exception. It carries no observed state: no counts, no hashes, no meeting
ids, no chat bodies, no credentials. See space/meeting-policy.schema.yaml
for the reasoning, and tests/test_meeting_relevance.py for the assertions
that hold this file to it.
SPACE-AND-RETENTION 7's content verdict. UNKNOWN is a real answer: it
means a stage had no input, and it is never a default to RELEVANT or to
IRRELEVANT.

values.RELEVANT: the bundle carries content the user's work needs
values.MIXED: part of the bundle is tied to work and part is not
values.IRRELEVANT: a confirmed rule excludes the bundle from work
values.UNKNOWN: no stage produced enough input to classify it

_comment: The closed set every record's `decision` is drawn from. The three
SPACE-AND-RETENTION 7 pipeline actions come first, then the REVIEW
family, then the cleanup and failure answers.
REJECTED is a caller bug. PROPOSAL_REQUIRED is a question for a human.
They are different answers and are never conflated.

values.INCLUDE_SEGMENTS: relevant content enters work, with its provenance
values.EXCLUDE_FROM_WORK: a confirmed rule excludes it; the original is untouched
values.REVIEW_NO_DELETE: a human decides, and deletion is forbidden while undecided
values.REVIEW_RELEVANT_SEGMENTS: a bound protected exception admits relevant segments only
values.REVIEW_PENDING: human-approved work depends on a now-excluded source; delta issued, nothing mutated
values.PLAN: every object in the cleanup plan is eligible
values.PARTIAL: some objects are eligible and some are not; per-object state is reported
values.PROPOSAL_REQUIRED: a rule a human must author is missing
values.REFUSAL: the request is refused; the policy or the object set does not permit it
values.UNSUPPORTED: the provider has no such action; a weaker action is never dressed as it
values.UNKNOWN: the operator could not be established
values.REJECTED: the request is malformed: a caller bug

cleanup_level._comment: SPACE-AND-RETENTION 8. A closed set of four, in ascending severity.

values.CONTENT_ISOLATION: exclude from work indexes and generated input; the original is untouched
values.REBUILDABLE_ARTIFACT_CLEANUP: clear this system's own stale caches, exports and superseded rebuildable drafts
values.CLOUD_RECOVERABLE_DISPOSAL: move objects this system owns into a provider recycle bin that really exists
values.IRREVERSIBLE_DELETE: permanently destroy recordings, transcripts, human documents or shared objects

stage._comment: SPACE-AND-RETENTION 7's pipeline, in order. Every stage is reported.

values.PRODUCED: the stage had the input it needed
values.NO_INPUT: the stage had no input; what follows it is UNKNOWN, never a default
values.AMBIGUOUS: more than one rule matched; a human resolves it
values.NOT_PERMITTED: the policy's allowed_content_depth forbids reading this content

ownership._comment: An axis independent of relevance. UNKNOWN defers.

values.OWNED: the user or this system owns the object and holds permission
values.SHARED: a shared session or a shared object

hold._comment: An axis independent of relevance, and of ownership.

values.UNKNOWN: whether a hold exists was not established

_comment: An axis independent of relevance, and the axis SPACE-AND-RETENTION 7
says must not be derived from it. The relevance kernel never evaluates
it: it reports NOT_EVALUATED. Only plan_cleanup() produces the others,
and only from its own eligibility inputs.

values.NOT_EVALUATED: the relevance kernel does not evaluate deletability at all
values.BLOCKED: the level or the provider refuses it

content_depth._comment: How deep a policy allows the kernel to read. METADATA_ONLY reads no content.

values.METADATA_ONLY: identity, participants, title and durations; no transcript and no audio
values.TRANSCRIPT: the provider's transcript, with time locations
values.FULL: transcript plus audio, when the policy's audio path permits it

delete_mode._comment: What a policy authorises. The ladder is deliberate: no level implies the next.

values.NO_DELETE: no cloud or irreversible deletion is authorised
values.RECYCLE_BIN: a provider recycle bin the operator verified exists
values.PERMANENT: irreversible destruction, always needing this operation's own approval

delete_mode_for_level._comment: The only delete_mode each level may run under. A mismatch is a refusal.

operation_for_level._comment: The policy operation each level requires. A policy is not reusable across levels.

values.RELEVANCE_CLASSIFICATION: classify a bundle; nothing is mutated
values.RESTORE: bring an object back from a provider recycle bin
values.REINDEX: rebuild a derived index after a restore

_comment: Whether a selector names a real tenant/chat/meeting. UNBOUND is not a
placeholder to be filled in later by a guess: while it is UNBOUND the
declaration selects nothing and the destructive path fails closed.

values.BOUND: a real stable identifier is declared and approved

_comment: SPACE-AND-RETENTION 7: support work is evidenced by chat, request,
configuration, test and result confirmation - not only by audio. The
non-audio path is first-class here, so excluding incidental audio does
not delete the work.

values.CONFIG_DIFF: a configuration change made while solving the problem
values.TEST_RESULT: a test or reproduction that shows the behaviour
values.RESULT_CONFIRMATION: the counterparty confirming the problem is solved
values.MEETING_AUDIO: the meeting recording or its transcript

observed_status._comment: What a previous attempt, read back from the provider, says about one object.

values.NOT_ATTEMPTED: nothing was attempted for this object
values.EXECUTED: the action succeeded and a receipt exists
values.RESTORED: the object was disposed of and has since been restored
values.FAILED: the action failed for a reason that may be transient

intent._comment: What the plan intends for one object. ALREADY_EXECUTED is never retried.

values.ISOLATE: level A: exclude from work indexes; the original stays
values.CLEAN_REBUILDABLE: level B: clear a cache, export or superseded rebuildable draft
values.DISPOSE: level C/D: act on the object
values.ALREADY_EXECUTED: read back as already done; not retried
values.REINDEX_REQUIRED: restored; derived indexes must be rebuilt and the candidate must not regrow
values.REFUSED: an eligibility input forbids this object
values.SKIP: eligible, but nothing is attempted this time

owner_constraint._comment: Whose objects a policy may touch. NONE refuses the destructive levels outright.

values.SELF_ONLY: only objects the user personally owns (owner_ref = self)
values.SYSTEM_OWNED_ONLY: only objects this system generated and can rebuild (owner_ref = system)
values.NONE: no constraint declared; the destructive path refuses

object_type._comment: What one MeetingBundle member physically is.

_comment: Work that used this bundle. A human-approved dependant is never silently
rewritten; a machine-generated draft is recomputable.

approval_mode._comment: What a policy demands before a level may run.

values.EXPLICIT: this operation's own explicit approval is required

record_approval._comment: What the decision record says it is standing on.

values.policy-approved: a human-approved rule already covers this
values.explicit: a human must answer before anything follows from this record

acceptance._comment: Whether a signal was even consulted. It never is.

values.RECORDED_INSUFFICIENT: recorded, and insufficient on its own to prove anything about business value

_comment: SPACE-AND-RETENTION 9. One policy shape for every operation, so a policy
that was read as a classification policy cannot later be re-read as one
that may dispose of objects without the destructive fields being filled.
An absent or null field is a REFUSAL that names the field.

reference_checks._comment: The checks a policy declares it performs before an object may be acted on.

_comment: Levels that remove or dispose of material, and therefore need an approved
retention. CONTENT_ISOLATION is not among them: it deletes nothing.
The only actions an unmatched bundle may receive. A policy cannot declare
unmatched: EXCLUDE_FROM_WORK or anything that deletes: unmatched means
unknown, and unknown is reviewed.
What a matched, confirmed source rule permits. `source_confirmed: false`
means the rule cannot exclude anything: the fail-closed direction is
REVIEW.

confirmed-muted-support-source.note: An accurately identified muted support source: incidental audio is excluded from understanding, board and report, and the work is evidenced without it.

confirmed-open-source.note: A confirmed source whose audio is admitted within the policy's allowed depth.

unconfirmed-source.note: No confirmed rule covers this source, so nothing may be excluded and no evidence path is opened on its behalf.

_comment: The user's one explicitly declared exception: a support group where the
microphone is open, so its audio is admitted. It is NOT 'everyone named
Marek' and NOT 'Polish in general'. No stable id for that group has been
obtained, so the declaration is UNBOUND and selects nothing at all.
title_or_name_matching_allowed is false, and this kernel has no title or
name matcher to allow: matching is by stable identifier only.
CONTRACT-hwz-ops section 4, carried as a DISABLED declaration. It is not
installed, it authorises nothing, and it deliberately fails the
executable-policy checks: its selectors are empty and its retention has
no approved policy and no days. A template is not consent.
SPACE-AND-RETENTION 7: audio duration, the user-muted boolean, language,
title, the participant list and the automatic summary each cannot on their
own prove that content has no business value. They are recorded and
recorded as insufficient. The kernel has no branch that reads them.
